text:
**Sunday**, and a lighter week is coming. There is no school on **Wednesday** for Veteran's Day, so it is only four school days.

Tutoring is **Monday** and **Tuesday**, and Little Medical School is on **Friday**. It is Gear Week at Tae Kwon Do, so put on your full gear before you leave for class.

The Read-a-thon starts the week after, on the **16th**. Today, pick the book you want to read for it and start the first chapter.
